BiblicalUsage: ʼErek was a city in the land of Shinar, in Nimrod's kingdom. The name occurs once, in Genesis. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼErek matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
